title: Arranging Wine
source_topic: ICPC / The 2017 ACM - Asia Ho Chi Minh City Regional Contest
statement: R boxes of red wine and W boxes of white wine are split into non-empty single-colour piles arranged in a line so that neighbouring piles always differ in colour, and every red pile holds at most d boxes while white piles are unlimited. The task is to count the distinct arrangements modulo 10^9+7, with R and W each up to one million.
